messages.subject: Degrees of freedom
parts:
Hello,

I noticed that the degrees of freedom in my data is constant across each protein after I run groupComparisonTMT. Is this something that is commonly observed or could indicate an issue in my analysis?

Kind Regards

Sam

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Degrees of freedom
parts:
Hey Sam,

This is due to missing values. When a protein is not measured in a run (or channel in TMT) we do not impute, we just fit the model with less replicates. This results in different numbers of degrees of freedom across proteins. I would expect you to see this less in TMT experiments with 1 mixture, but more if you include additional mixtures.

Devon
